# truenas_ui_restart (Action)

Restarts the TrueNAS web UI (system.general.ui_restart).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Restart the TrueNAS web UI after a config change (Terraform 1.14+).
action "truenas_ui_restart" "example" {
  config {
    delay = 0
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `delay` (Number) Seconds to wait before restarting the UI (default 0).
